answer.rationale: Memory 57 is the strongest direct support because it reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm, though it does not establish long-term durability or experimental rigor. Memories 73 and 44 connect to acquisition/revenue or pipeline quality but omit retention, customer quality over time, margins, and causal-method details. Memory 31 reports a durable activation lift, making it more relevant than a purely short-term engagement result, but it does not link activation to qualified revenue or retention. Memories 86 and 91 show early adoption or week-one engagement improvements only; neither demonstrates qualified revenue, retention, durability, or methodology. Memory 86 is least supported because it is limited to onboarding completion, time-to-value, and early adoption, with no stated durable or revenue outcome.
